venue: GMOアリーナさいたま（さいたまスーパーアリーナ）
builtBefore: any human visual transcription pass. No human Pass 1 or Pass 2 exists for this venue anywhere in the repository as of this date, so this extractor provably cannot have been derived from one.

independence.note: The extractor reads only the chart raster. seat_list.js was never opened by the extractor and is not usable as seat-structure evidence. Issuer subtotals appear in this document only as a comparison column and were not used to tune any threshold.

quarantineNotice: A future fresh independent human visual Pass 1 or Pass 2 session must NOT open this file before it has frozen its own transcription. The per-region machine cell counts here would otherwise anchor that pass. Open it only at the cross-check step.

chartAsset.note: The seat chart itself is the raster. The SVG wrapper carries only a background image reference to this PNG, a vector gate-number layer and zero-opacity highlight polygons. No seat number, row label or seat polygon exists in vector form, so DENSE-VECTOR verification is not available for this venue and the ordinary fresh independent human visual two-pass remains mandatory.

stagePositionVariants.method: All four current rasters were fetched fresh and compared pixelwise on the composited-on-white RGB with a per-pixel magnitude threshold of 150 summed over channels, which rejects the palette/antialiasing noise present at magnitude <= 6, then dilated 2px before classifying detected cells.
stagePositionVariants.finding: Every stage-position difference is confined to the arena floor and stage area inside the bounding box above. All seat cells, teal seat-number glyph cells and magenta row-label glyphs outside that area are identical across all four stage positions. The fixed numbered seating of this mode is therefore stage-position invariant, and only the floor area is event-dependent.
stagePositionVariants.excludedFromScope: Cells touching a stage-position change are excluded from the structural checksum as issuer-declared event-dependent arena-floor seating. Issuer statement on the current 客席確認・案内 page: 固定席の一部を収納してアリーナ席を設置する場合もございます。設置される席・ブロック数・列・席番号などにつきましては、イベント主催者にお問合せください。

method: The raster is composited onto white; the PNG carries an alpha channel and the page renders it on white.

Seat cells are drawn as closed rectangles with a light-grey outline (RGB 182,182,182 with darker 110,110,110 segments) on a white interior, separated by white gaps. Run-endpoint cells are filled solid teal (RGB 39,158,182); row labels are magenta (RGB 255,31,176).

Outline-enclosed cells are recovered as 4-connected components of near-white (mean channel >= 236) that do not touch the image border, with area 25..400 px, bounding box 4..30 px on each side and fill ratio >= 0.45.
Teal endpoint cells are recovered separately as 4-connected components of the teal fill within the same size and fill-ratio envelope, because those cells have no white interior.
Cells are classified as stage-invariant or stage-variant by the four-variant comparison described above.

Seating regions are the connected components of the stage-invariant cell centroid set under a 13px binary dilation, which bridges the gap between adjacent seats inside one printed block but not the aisles between blocks.

Row-band topology is reported only for regions whose cells are at least 75% within +/-1 px of the region-dominant cell width and height, i.e. axis-aligned regions. The rotated arc regions are reported at region level only.

issuerComparison.note: Post-check comparison column only. No range, threshold or count in this document was tuned to these figures.

limitations: Under-segmentation: where a cell outline is broken, or two adjacent outlines merge through antialiasing, two cells label as one component and the machine count falls short. This failure mode can only lower the machine count, never raise it.
Partially drawn cells at a block edge, and cells whose outline is overdrawn by a printed teal or magenta glyph, can fall below the area floor and be dropped.
The machine path counts drawn polygons. It cannot read a seat number or a row label and therefore cannot confirm, supply or complete any seat identifier. It is a cross-check only.

Level ownership per region is reported as a nearest-gate distance only and is explicitly NOT an area assignment: gate proximity mis-assigns outer-ring regions, and area ownership must be read directly from the chart during the human pass.
Row-band counts are geometric band counts, not issuer 列 labels, and the two need not agree where a block has a staircase edge or a cross-aisle.

verdict.reason: No human visual transcription pass exists for this configuration yet. This artifact establishes the machine side of the cross-check required by docs/VENUE_DATA_GUIDE.md so that a later human two-pass can be reconciled against it. It is not by itself a production gate result.
verdict.machineStructuralCountPracticalEvidence: 25192 discrete seat cells were recovered from the raster alone, 95.0% of the issuer level-subtotal sum 26511, in 119 separated regions with two clean cell-size families. The "machine structural count is impractical" waiver in docs/VENUE_DATA_GUIDE.md must not be used for this venue.
